note: PARTIAL GT: 654x469 winter street photo, Russian billboard. Annotated 2026-07-31 by 4x crop verification against a pixel grid. The slogan lines read 'Za ПОБЕДУ!' / 'Za НАШИХ!' / 'Za ПРАВДУ!' where 'Za' is genuinely LATIN (the Russian war symbol) set against Cyrillic -- so a Latin read of those three tokens is CORRECT, not a homoglyph error. The three Za are staggered, not stacked: their glyph left edges sit at x354, x393 and x368. Boxes are at DETECTOR scale (glyph extent plus the margin the recognizer needs), NOT tight to the glyphs: an earlier version of this file used measured glyph extents and scored recall 0.182 because e.g. a 22px-tall box for 'ПОБЕДУ!' only reaches IoU 0.45 against the detector's 46px-tall box -- that measured the annotation, not the detection. The Za boxes for lines 1 and 3 are glyph extent padded to match the line-2 Za box the detector gets right. Marked partial because the blurred city background carries real distant signage that cannot be transcribed; the low-confidence 'Fpg' read at (127,352) lives there and is a genuine false positive, tracked via garbage fraction rather than precision. The three sub-resolution regions (two hashtags at ~6px cap height and the billboard's 'M 0397 A' plate) carry null text: the boxes are certain, the glyph case is not, so they credit recall without being scored for edit distance. The Za merge this file used to pin -- lines 1 and 3 collapsed into a single 47x77 column by merge_vertical_columns, a CJK stacked-signage heuristic firing on Latin -- is fixed; all three read as separate regions. What remains is that they read as 'ZA', and that is NOT recoverable from the image. Measured 2026-08-01: the two glyphs are drawn at the SAME cap height (base components (6,8,21,27) and (22,6,40,25), heights 19 and 19), so Savor's case signature reports 'tall','tall' and the all-cap read is a faithful transcription of the letterforms. 'Za' is the conventional spelling of the symbol, not something the pixels distinguish. A lowering branch added to case_signature_verdict to recover it was written, measured and reverted: it could not fire here for want of any height evidence, and on rue-des-martyrs it fired on a mis-segmented plate ('RUE' -> 'Rue', edit distance 0.000 -> 0.222) -- corrupting a correct read on one asset to fix nothing on another. The three Za are the whole of this asset's 0.188 edit distance and are expected to stay there.
